```go
func handlePayment(req PaymentRequest) error {
  key := req.IdempotencyKey
  if seen(key) { return nil }
  err := process(req)
  if err != nil { return retryWithBackoff(req) }

}
```

```python
import math

def kl_div(p, q):
    return sum(pi * math.log(pi/qi) for pi, qi in zip(p, q) if pi > 0 and qi > 0)

def drift_exceeds(p, q, thr=0.1):
    return kl_div(p, q) > thr
```
